vc_checking.summary: All three target manual witnesses are semantically derivable from the current xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg predicates. They share one bounded proof group because each proof is a split or recomposition of the same sentinel DLL segment around linklist_node; no cross-group dependency or new helper declaration is required.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: Choose the second Coq disjunct. P owns xizi_dllseg first_2 linklist_pre linklist_pre last_2 (nodes_before ++ linklist_node_pre :: nodes_after).
vc_shape.pre_pure: PreH1 gives linklist_pre <> 0 and PreH3 gives linklist_node_pre <> 0; PreH2 duplicates the sentinel non-null fact.
vc_shape.pre_exists: No existential is exposed in the selected segment branch before the proof; the internal successor and predecessor at the split point are obtained while recursively unfolding the segment.
vc_shape.post_spatial: Q asks for the prefix segment ending at linklist_node_pre, the two owned link fields of linklist_node_pre, and the suffix segment ending at the sentinel.
vc_shape.post_exists: Instantiate node_prev with the predecessor carried at the end of the prefix and node_next with the successor exposed by unfolding the linklist_node_pre cell.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Induct on nodes_before. In the nil case the input segment starts with linklist_node_pre, so unfolding provides node_next and fixes node_prev = linklist_pre. In the cons case retain the exposed head link, apply the induction hypothesis to the tail, and use its split predecessor/successor witnesses.
witnesses.space_plan: Unfold xizi_dllseg along nodes_before. The base case exposes exactly xizi_dll_links linklist_node_pre node_next linklist_pre and the nodes_after suffix. The inductive case frames the current xizi_dll_links cell around the recursively split tail and folds the prefix segment back. Unfold xizi_dll_links only when matching the two generated points-to cells.
witnesses.pure_plan: The two post non-null facts are discharged directly by PreH1 and PreH3. Pure equalities introduced by the nil/cons equations of xizi_dllseg determine the chosen existential addresses; no arithmetic premise is needed.
witnesses.refinement_plan: Not applicable: this is a direct spatial entailment with no safeExec or abstract-program state.
premise_discharge: segment endpoint and predecessor equalities come from the nil branch of xizi_dllseg during the prefix induction
the split node's successor resource and remaining suffix are the cons branch of xizi_dllseg
witnesses.failure_signal: None: every requested spatial resource is a partition of the single precondition segment, and every pure premise is present or follows from the predicate equations.
witnesses.grouping_reason: This is the split direction of the same xizi_dllseg prefix/current/suffix identity used in reverse by both return witnesses.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: Choose the second Coq disjunct. P owns the prefix segment to linklist_node_pre, both link fields of linklist_node_pre, and xizi_dllseg node_next linklist_node_pre linklist_pre last nodes_after.
vc_shape.pre_pure: PreH1 states node_next = linklist_pre; PreH2 and PreH3 give sentinel and current-node non-null facts.
vc_shape.pre_exists: No right-side existential is required in this return branch.
vc_shape.post_spatial: Q requires one recomposed xizi_dllseg from first to linklist_pre with logical list nodes_before ++ linklist_node_pre :: nodes_after.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Substitute node_next = linklist_pre. Destruct nodes_after: a cons suffix is impossible because the nonempty branch of xizi_dllseg asserts its start is different from its stop; therefore nodes_after = nil and the value definition reduces to 0.
witnesses.space_plan: After the empty-suffix fact is exposed, the suffix segment reduces to emp plus endpoint equations. Induct on nodes_before to fold the prefix segment together with the owned linklist_node_pre link fields into the requested full segment. The endpoint equation from the empty suffix supplies the final predecessor/last equality.
witnesses.pure_plan: PreH1 identifies the suffix start with its stop. Destructing nodes_after and unfolding xizi_dllseg refutes the cons case via linklist_pre <> linklist_pre; in the nil case unfold xizi_double_link_next_rec_last_value to prove 0 = 0. No arithmetic is involved.
witnesses.refinement_plan: Not applicable: this is a direct spatial entailment with no safeExec or abstract-program state.
premise_discharge: the impossibility of a nonempty suffix follows from the cons branch guard node_next <> linklist_pre after PreH1
nodes_after = nil makes xizi_double_link_next_rec_last_value nodes_after definitionally 0
the last-address equality used in folding comes from the nil branch of the suffix xizi_dllseg
witnesses.failure_signal: None: the branch guard forces precisely the empty logical suffix required by the result-value definition, and all owned cells are preserved during recomposition.
witnesses.grouping_reason: This is the empty-suffix recomposition case of the same DLL-segment identity.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: Choose the second Coq disjunct. P owns the tail segment after node_next, node_next's two link fields, the prefix segment before linklist_node_pre, and linklist_node_pre's two link fields.
vc_shape.pre_pure: PreH1 states nodes_after = node_next :: l0; PreH2 states node_next <> linklist_pre; PreH3 and PreH4 give non-null facts for the sentinel and current node.
vc_shape.pre_exists: The already-bound next and l0 are exactly the successor and tail exposed from the nonempty suffix.
vc_shape.post_spatial: Q requires one segment from first to linklist_pre for nodes_before ++ linklist_node_pre :: nodes_after.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Rewrite nodes_after using PreH1. The value definition immediately returns node_next. The spatial suffix node_next :: l0 is represented by node_next's owned links followed by xizi_dllseg next node_next linklist_pre last l0.
witnesses.space_plan: Fold the node_next cell and its tail into the nonempty nodes_after suffix, then induct on nodes_before to fold the prefix and linklist_node_pre cell around that suffix. The resulting list is nodes_before ++ linklist_node_pre :: nodes_after, exactly the post segment.
witnesses.pure_plan: Rewrite PreH1 and simplify xizi_double_link_next_rec_last_value; the goal becomes node_next = node_next. The xizi_dllseg cons guards already present in the spatial resources justify the nonempty structure; no new pure hypothesis is required.
witnesses.refinement_plan: Not applicable: this is a direct spatial entailment with no safeExec or abstract-program state.
premise_discharge: nodes_after = node_next :: l0 is exactly PreH1
node_next <> linklist_pre is exactly PreH2 and matches the nonempty suffix guard
the next/prev points-to resources for node_next are explicit in P
the tail segment xizi_dllseg next node_next linklist_pre last l0 is explicit in P
witnesses.failure_signal: None: the precondition is already the fully unfolded nonempty suffix plus the prefix/current-node partition needed for recomposition.
witnesses.grouping_reason: This is the nonempty-suffix recomposition case of the same DLL-segment identity.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Induction on nodes_before establishes the inverse split/fold identity for xizi_dllseg around linklist_node_pre; the two return cases then discharge the result value by empty/nonempty case analysis on nodes_after.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Use direct recursive unfolding/folding of xizi_dllseg and xizi_dll_links, preserving every points-to resource. Select the segment alternative of each top-level Coq disjunction so no sentinel link resource has to be invented or discarded.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Use the explicit non-null and branch equalities. The equal-start/stop segment forces nodes_after=nil for return_wit_1; PreH1 exposes nodes_after=node_next::l0 for return_wit_2.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: All three witnesses concern one function, one predicate family, one prefix parameter, and inverse directions of the same segment decomposition. With 3 witnesses this is within the controller maximum of 12 and avoids duplicating the induction context.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Unfold each witness and select its second (segment-only) Coq disjunct. Prove entail_wit_1 by induction on nodes_before, splitting xizi_dllseg at linklist_node_pre and choosing the exposed predecessor/successor. Prove return_wit_1 by substituting node_next=linklist_pre, deriving nodes_after=nil from the equal-start/stop suffix, simplifying the result value, and inductively folding the prefix/current node. Prove return_wit_2 by rewriting nodes_after=node_next::l0, simplifying the result value, and inductively folding the prefix/current node/nonempty suffix. Keep helpers local to the theorem proof; no top-level case_lib declaration is needed.

per_witness_plan.proof_of_xizi_double_link_next_rec_last_: Right disjunct; nodes_before induction; recursive segment split; existential predecessor/successor from the split point.
Right disjunct; substitute equal-to-sentinel branch; rule out a cons nodes_after; fold prefix plus current node.
Right disjunct; rewrite nonempty nodes_after; simplify value; fold next node, current node, and prefix.
